blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Questions surfaced over whether the release of ₱50 million in confidential funds released near the end of two government periods complied with auditing rules. Local councilors here on Tuesday, November 3 debated whether the transactions warranted a separate investigation or could be addressed through the Commission on Audit’s (COA) existing audit process. The discussion centered on two cash advances under former Mayor Raymond Alvin Garcia’s administration: ₱40 million released on Dec. 27, 2024, and ₱10 million on June 27, 2025, three days before his term ended.
